findings.description: INFORMATIONAL / NON-BLOCKING (re-check of prior P3 #6, now accepted). options = {"shared": [True, False]} / default_options = {"shared": True} are declared but build() never reads self.options.shared — the recipe always emits the single shared loadable module vector.so. Accepted as-is because (a) it is the repo family convention: the sibling PG-extension recipes postgresql-hypopg/1.4.2, postgresql-sequential-uuids/1.0.3 and postgresql-topn/2.7.0 all declare the same non-honored `shared` option; and (b) the intent is now documented in two comments (class attribute lines 56-58 and package_info lines 176-183: 'loadable module, not a link library; the option is declarative only'). Minor wording note: Conan does not strictly *force* a `shared` option for package_type="library" (it is a convention), so the phrase 'Conan requires the shared option' is slightly imprecise — harmless, no functional impact.
findings.fix_suggestion: No action required (matches sibling recipes and is documented). If strict honoring is ever wanted, the minimal compliant form is to keep the option and add in configure(): if not self.options.shared: raise ConanInvalidConfiguration("pgvector ships a shared dlopen loadable module; shared=False is unsupported") — but this is optional and not requested by any rule.

findings.description: INFORMATIONAL / NON-BLOCKING (prior P3 #3 revisited). upstream_test_count: 62 aggregates 14 pg_regress groups + 48 Perl TAP scripts, whereas the sibling recipes encode this field as pg_regress-groups-only (postgresql-topn/2.7.0 = 8, postgresql-sequential-uuids/1.0.3 = 1). The fix added a self-documenting upstream_test_count_breakdown field (line 12: '14 pg_regress groups (test/sql/*.sql) + 48 Perl TAP scripts (test/t/*.pl)') and restored upstream_test_groups to the 14 actual group names (lines 13-27), which now matches the sibling convention for that field. The remaining numeric difference is intentional and now documented, so it is non-blocking.
findings.fix_suggestion: Optional only: for byte-level uniformity with the siblings you could set upstream_test_count to 14 (pg_regress groups) and keep 62 elsewhere, or leave as-is now that the breakdown documents the composition. No rule requires either.
